content.comment_body: Hello. Each time a project is saved, a log is created. I am looking for a way to remove this data from a project. Is there a method to achieve this? Thank you in advance.

Are you trying to delete all records in the save history? You can do this by highlighting the entries and using the "Del" key. However, even when selecting multiple items, typically only about half get removed at a time. You can keep repeating this process to delete all entries except for the last one.

analysis.insight_summary: The main topic centers on removing save history from a project. Users can delete most save logs, but the very last entry cannot be removed, meaning a complete reset is not fully possible. This limitation could be problematic for those wanting full privacy or a fresh project state.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to have an option to eliminate all save and change history from their project.
